Maintain and calibrate QC instruments, and help with warehouse hygiene inspections.

job_description: Job Summary The Senior Electrical Engineer will be responsible for leading, planning, designing, supervising, and executing electrical engineering works across high-rise buildings, commercial complexes, residential developments, industrial facilities, and other construction projects. The role requires extensive technical expertise, strong leadership, cost-control capabilities, and the ability to ensure that all electrical installations comply with approved designs, project specifications, applicable codes, and safety standards. Job Responsibilities: Electrical Design & Engineering Review, verify, and approve electrical drawings, load calculations, single-line diagrams (SLD), and technical specifications. Supervise electrical system design, including power distribution, transformers, substations, generators, ATS/AMF panels, MDB, SMDB, DB, and electrical risers. Oversee the design and installation of lighting, emergency lighting, earthing, lightning protection, and power backup systems. Review electrical shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and technical documentation. Coordinate with consultants, architects, structural engineers, and MEP teams to resolve design conflicts and technical issues. Ensure compliance with applicable Bangladesh Electrical Rules, BNBC, relevant IEC/IEEE standards, and utility-provider requirements. Project Execution & Site Supervision Lead and supervise all electrical installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities. Develop electrical work plans, execution schedules, manpower requirements, and resource allocation strategies. Monitor site progress against approved project schedules and ensure timely completion of electrical works. Conduct regular site inspections to ensure workmanship, installation quality, and compliance with approved drawings. Coordinate electrical works with civil, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, fire protection, and interior finishing teams. Identify technical challenges, resolve site-level issues, and implement corrective actions to minimize project delays. Power Distribution & Electrical Infrastructure Supervise installation and commissioning of HT/LT systems, substations, transformers, generators, switchgear, bus ducts, and cable networks. Ensure proper cable sizing, voltage-drop calculations, load balancing, short-circuit protection, and coordination of protective devices. Oversee installation of electrical shafts, cable trays, conduits, trunking, and underground electrical infrastructure. Monitor power factor correction, energy metering, electrical reliability, and load-management systems. Coordinate utility connections, electrical inspections, and necessary approvals with relevant authorities. Budgeting, Cost Control & Procurement Prepare and review electrical BOQs, cost estimates, budget forecasts, and material requirement schedules. Monitor electrical project expenditure against approved budgets and identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising safety or quality. Review supplier quotations, technical comparisons, material specifications, and procurement recommendations. Verify contractor bills, work measurements, material consumption, and variation claims. Control material wastage, prevent unnecessary expenditure, and maintain accurate records of electrical inventory. Support tender preparation, contract administration, change orders, and final account settlement. Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC) Establish and enforce electrical quality-control procedures, inspection plans, and testing protocols. Review inspection requests, material inspection reports, and electrical testing documentation. Supervise insulation resistance, continuity, earth resistance, relay protection, functional, and load testing as applicable. Ensure all electrical installations pass required inspections and comply with project specifications. Identify non-conformities and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions. Maintain commissioning reports, inspection records, test certificates, and as-built drawings. Safety & Regulatory Compliance Enforce electrical safety procedures, permit-to-work systems, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and safe isolation practices. Ensure proper protection against electric shock, short circuits, overloads, fire hazards, and electrical accidents. Conduct safety inspections, risk assessments, and toolbox meetings with engineers, supervisors, and contractors. Ensure appropriate PPE, safe working practices, and compliance with applicable occupational health and safety requirements. Investigate electrical incidents and implement preventive measures. Team Leadership & Contractor Management Lead, mentor, and supervise electrical engineers, junior engineers, supervisors, technicians, and subcontractors. Assign responsibilities, establish performance targets, and monitor team productivity. Conduct technical meetings with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project management teams. Evaluate contractor performance, manpower deployment, work quality, and adherence to contractual obligations. Provide technical guidance and support for complex electrical engineering and construction issues. Testing, Commissioning & Project Handover Develop and monitor electrical testing and commissioning plans. Supervise integrated testing of electrical systems, backup power systems, emergency lighting, and associated control systems. Ensure all defects and punch-list items are resolved before handover. Prepare operation and maintenance (O&M) manuals, warranties, test reports, and equipment documentation. Coordinate final inspections, authority approvals, client demonstrations, and handover activities. Support facility management teams during the transition from construction to operation. Energy Efficiency & System Reliability Recommend energy-efficient electrical equipment, LED lighting, efficient transformers, and optimized power distribution solutions. Monitor energy consumption and identify opportunities to reduce operating costs. Evaluate electrical system performance, reliability, and maintenance requirements. Implement preventive maintenance strategies and recommend improvements to reduce downtime. Support the integration of building automation, energy monitoring, and smart electrical systems where required. Reporting & Management Coordination Submit periodic electrical progress reports, budget updates, procurement status, risk assessments, and commissioning reports. Report project delays, technical risks, quality issues, and cost variations to the Project Manager or Head of Engineering. Maintain accurate documentation of drawings, approvals, inspection records, and project correspondence. Participate in project review meetings and provide technical recommendations for management decisions. Ensure electrical deliverables are completed in line with project milestones and contractual requirements.
skills_required: High rise and Multi storied Building, Hospital, shopping mall
